items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Dev Acknowledges That Chaos Is Harder to Fight Than Tyranids, Confirms Plan to Do Something About It
items.summary: Ever since Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2’s 2024 launch, players have said that the Chaos enemies are harder

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/19/spacemarines2-thumb-1779213107792.jpg

Ever since Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2’s 2024 launch, players have said that the Chaos enemies are harder to fight than the Tyranids. Well, now Space Marine 2’s game director has come out and admitted that is indeed the case — and confirmed plans to do something about it.

For the uninitiated, the Tyranids are a swarm-type enemy type that packs the screen with a mix of smaller foes and much bigger, harder-hitting foes. There’s a bloody minded pleasure that comes from chewing through scores of Tyranid enemies as a Space Marine, sweeping your Power Sword through xenos flesh, parrying a strike that gives you a clean response, and — my personal favorite — punching those Tyranids in the face with my Power Fist.

In contrast, the Thousand Sons present a more measured challenge. You are, after all, going up against fellow Space Marines here and their daemonic forces; they’re supposed to be tough. When those Terminators spawn and spam their missile barrage, playing against Chaos can feel like pulling teeth. The Thousand Sons are less of a 'switch your brain off and cleave through it' proposition, and more of a, 'if Space Marine 2 wanted to be a bit like Elden Ring, it would probably go a little like this.'

The effect is more pronounced the harder the difficulty you play. At easier difficulties, the Tyranids and Chaos are much of a muchness in terms of challenge. But ramp the difficulty up — which you need to do for certain levels of progression in Space Marine 2 — and Chaos becomes an absolute bloody nightmare, whereas the Tyranids often still feel manageable.

For this reason, Space Marine 2 players have for years now said the Tyranids are more fun to play against than Chaos , and I certainly agree. But in a Reddit AMA , game director Dmitry Grigorenko not only acknowledged that Chaos are harder, but said there is work being done to tweak the balance between the two enemy factions.

“We understand that Chaos is more difficult to fight against Tyranids, yes,” Grigorenko said . “There will be some pass on this in the future. I don't think it will be about bots being good vs Chaos specifically, though.”

That latter part of the answer is a response to the suggestion that Space Marine 2 should balance Chaos Operations (PvE missions) so it’s easier to fight against them as a solo player. With that ruled out, what could Grigorenko be talking about here? Perhaps it’s about a nerf to the entire faction, whether it be toughness, damage, or even spawn intensity. There are lots of things Saber could do here, although the fundamentals of how Chaos works in the game versus the Tyranids won’t change. Chaos are Space Marines after all.

I suspect that no matter what Saber does here, the Tyranids will always be more fun to fight than Chaos. That’s because you simply can't beat the feeling that comes from carving your way through the swarm, or pumping scores of alien monsters with bolter fire. That’s kind of the way this works. Still, I wouldn’t mind a tweak that makes me wince a little less whenever I’m up against Chaos.

My thoughts have inevitably turned to Space Marine 3, which is in development. What will be the “swarm” enemy here? Most believe Space Marine 3 will feature the Necrons, based on hints sprinkled throughout Space Marine 2. But what other factions would fit the bill? A return to the Orks seen in Space Marine 1? (Orks are the primary antagonist of the 11th edition of the Warhammer 40,000 tabletop game.) How about a focus on the relentless Death Guard and swarms of shuffling Plaguebearers?

items.title: God of War Laufey Features Kratos in an Ancient Greek Setting, Sparking Speculation Over the Game's Story — and Praise for His Big Bushy Beard
items.summary: Chinstrap in.

others.title: God of War Laufey PS5 Editions Revealed, Pre-Order Tomorrow

content.v: Fans are discussing a new God of War Laufey screenshot featuring fan-favorite hero Kratos, in a setting resembling Ancient Greece.

The image was revealed today via the PlayStation blog , alongside details of the game's preorder bonuses and digital deluxe edition. The screenshot shows Laufey's eponymous heroine with Kratos, with the pair standing in what looks to be a Greek temple.

Why is this interesting? Well, because Laufey is supposed to be dead and separated from Kratos, and she never visited Ancient Greece during his time there, which occured long before they met. So, what's going on?

Firstly, while Laufey is very much the star of this new game, fans have already seen Kratos pop up a couple of times at its beginning, in footage released back when the game was revealed in June . First, the bearded demigod can be seen burning Laufey's body on a funeral pyre, an event which took place at the start of the 2018 God of War game.

Laufey then re-awakens in the Everywhen — a heavenly place that serves as an afterlife for gods of all mythologies — and it's here that Kratos visits her again in a moment of need, albeit only momentarily. When this scene was shown earlier this year, however, it was not clear if Kratos would feature further in the game, or this was something of a one-off.

Today's screenshot answers that question, but then asks several more. Which version of Kratos is this? Is it the version that's still alive and living through the events of 2018's God of War and its sequel Ragnarök? If so, when exactly in his timeline does this take place? Alternatively, could this be a version of Kratos that has also found himself in the Everywhen via other means (perhaps after his eventual final death)?

And what about that Ancient Greek setting? Is this a corner of the Everywhen that Laufey will visit, themed around Greek mythology? Will other familiar faces from the first God of War trilogy make a reappearance here too?
"Where the hell are they?" God of War fan Iluminado_Horn wrote on video game forum ResetEra. "In Greece? After Ragnarok?"
"Laufey dreams/hallucinates of Kratos, it was shown on the gameplay reveal," responded another fan, Patitoloco. "This could be anywhere in the game, or a flashback."

Last, but certainly not least, this image has sparked praise for Kratos' exquisitely bushy beard, which has been rendered on PlayStation 5 Pro in fine detail. While this isn't our first time gazing at the game running on PS5 Pro, it is certainly impressive when you take a moment to appreciate it.
God of War Laufey will launch exclusively for PlayStation 5 early next year, on February 16, 2027.

items.title: 《我的世界：地下城2》简评：刷宝ARPG再进一步

others.title: 我的世界地下城 2 评论

content.v: 由 Mojang Studios 与 Double Eleven 联合开发、Xbox Game Studios 发行的《我的世界：地下城2》是动作角色扮演游戏《我的世界：地下城》的续作，即将于 9 月 29 日正式登陆 PC、PS5、NS/NS2、XBOX 平台，首发加入 XGP。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231027-1923-51794.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

本作在保留前作等距视角刷宝ARPG核心框架的基础上，对多个系统进行了调整。最直观的变化在于地图结构：前作采用“据点—选任务—打地牢—回据点”的关卡选择制，续作则将不同生物群系整合进一张开放世界地图中，玩家可以在任务路线之外自由探索、测试配装或与队友闲逛，不过具体任务和地下城内部依然保持线性流程。装备系统也经历了显著扩展，盔甲不再是一件整体装备，而是拆分为四个独立部件，同时新增了提供被动效果的“护符”类别。附魔机制的变化尤为关键：前作的附魔与特定装备绑定，续作改为通过探索获取附魔书，再由附魔匠将其应用到任意选定的装备上，更换装备后不再受原有附魔组合的束缚。此外，前作没有的跳跃动作在本作中加入，为战斗和探索提供了新的操作维度。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231027-4212-37653.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231028-7157-18009.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
战斗与成长机制延续了前作“无固定职业约束”的高自由度设定，玩家的战斗定位完全由Build决定。通过组合近战与远程武器、护甲、神器以及各类附魔，可以自由调整出倾向于爆发、控场或生存的独特玩法。本作大幅扩展了装备的成长上限与属性联动，随着角色等级提升，玩家可解锁更高的附魔等级并搜寻更多传奇品质的独家装备。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231028-5945-37179.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231029-5649-70384.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

剧情方面，续作延续了初代结尾的悬念。三名灾厄村民在地下深处发现了一座通往神秘维度“筛界”的传送门，并利用其中由灵魂驱动的能量向主世界发动攻击，由此拉开了两个世界之间冲突的序幕。作为首次在《地下城2》中亮相的全新生态，筛界拥有奇幻的地貌、独立的秘境机制、专属方块以及大量全新的敌对生物。玩家需要穿梭于主世界与筛界之间，阻止意图打破多界平衡的全新邪恶势力。玩家将再度扮演英雄，穿越“深暗之域”等《我的世界》主系列中首次被引入衍生作品的区域，面对包括“扭曲监守者”在内的新敌人。故事基调延续了“一切安好，直到不再安好”的转折感，核心依然是合作对抗崛起的邪恶势力。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231029-5158-69525.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

在多人体验上，游戏支持单人游玩或最多4人的在线与本地分屏合作，且跨平台联机在发售时即已确认支持。挑战难度较前作有所提升，敌人数量与强度均有增加，开发团队在保留易于上手的操作感的同时，也在装备构筑和技能搭配层面为深度玩家留出了更充裕的策略空间。整体而言，《我的世界：地下城2》试图在“拿起手柄就能玩”的轻快节奏与“值得反复琢磨”的ARPG深度之间寻找更精确的平衡点，既维持了方块世界的童趣外观，又在系统层面朝着更成熟的刷宝动作游戏方向迈进了一步。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231030-6055-20377.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0928/20260928231030-4881-23830.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

items.title: Resident Evil Movie Demolishes Franchise Record After Just Two Weekends
items.summary: Zach Cregger's highly acclaimed Resident Evil movie had another strong showing at the box office for its secon

content.v: Zach Cregger's highly acclaimed Resident Evil movie had another strong showing at the box office for its second weekend, propelling the film to break another franchise record. It already broke the record for biggest opening weekend for the franchise , and now the movie has made more than $100 million domestically.

That's a new record for the franchise--before this, the biggest success domestically for the franchise was 2010's Resident Evil: Afterlife ($60 million). Globally, Resident Evil has now made $196.5 million against a reported $75 million production budget (not counting marketing costs).
The highest-grossing Resident Evil movie globally is Resident Evil: The Final Chapter, which made $312 million worldwide. Time will tell if 2026's Resident Evil will catch up.
Check out the list below to see how the other mainstream theatrical Resident Evil movies did at the domestic box office.

Director Paul W.S. Anderson made six Resident Evil movies that starred his wife, Milla Jovovich, and while none of them individually did very well commercially or critically, they combined to earn over $1 billion worldwide.

The worst-performing theatrical Resident Evil movie was 2021's Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City, which made just $17 million domestically. It was directed by Johannes Roberts and starred Kaya Scodelario as Claire Redfield and Avan Jogia as Leon S. Kennedy.
After that film disappointed, rights-owner Constantin put the franchise on hiatus and planned to keep it on ice until Cregger came to the company with a pitch for Resident Evil .

His movie is doing great, so people are wondering if there will be a sequel. That remains to be seen, and while Cregger has said he has ideas for where they story could go next , he's also said he is finished with franchise movies .
The Resident Evil movie is a huge success, but the recent lift in sales of games in the series is not completely attributable to that, according to a research firm.

items.title: 了解《巫师 3：狂猎 - 重制版》中有哪些新内容！
items.summary: Prepare yourself before returning to the Path! The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered releases tomorrow, Septem

content.v: Prepare yourself before returning to the Path!

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered releases tomorrow, September 29th. If you purchased any version of the game on Steam, you will be able to upgrade for free to the Remastered version as soon as it releases.
While you wait, we've prepared a list of most important changes coming to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt with the Remastered Upgrade. Please have a look below:
Implemented an improved shading model.
Updated multiple textures and models based on assets from The Witcher 3 HD Reworked Project .
Improved lighting and shading for grass and foliage.
Updated the visual effects of Signs, including their upgrade versions.
Added new visual effects for skills.
The game now features native DirectX 12 rendering with multithreading for better performance and visuals.
Updated tone mapping for improved colors, lighting, contrast and detail.
Added GTAO (Ground Truth Ambient Occlusion) as a new Screen Space Ambient Occlusion option.
Updated the HDR calibration panel by adding new options and other improvements.
Added Ray-Traced HairWorks for improved lighting and shading on hair.
Improved Motion Blur with a higher-quality, more cinematic look.
Updated Subsurface Scattering for more natural skin rendering.
Improved terrain and material rendering for more natural lighting, shadows, reflections, and highlights.
Implemented new Image-Based Lighting (IBL) for improved ambient lighting and reflections across different environments.
Reworked Bloom for more improved lighting effects across different environments.

Improved the skill system. Skills are now organized into a skill tree and each skill has three ranks. Unlocking new skills now requires having the necessary prerequisite skills rather than spending a set number of skill points. IMPORTANT: As a result of these changes, your skill points have been reset.
Rebalanced the skill tree by refining skill bonus values, effects and synergies.
Renamed some skills to better reflect their effects.

You can now Reforge your equipment to change its appearance without affecting its stats. Only master craftsmen (Yoana and Hattori) offer this service. Unlock appearances by adding new equipment and crafting diagrams to your inventory. Dyes from Blood and Wine applied to equipment will carry over to the reforged item.
Polished the combat behavior of all non-boss monsters, including their attack patterns, counterattacks, movement, reactions, flight and the application of effects.
Cantering and galloping now requires pressing the button instead of holding it.
Added a new "Horse control input sensitivity" slider in Settings → Controls.
Improved Roach's and Geralt's movement, player control and animations:
Refined Geralt's jumping animation so that it feels more natural and polished. Note: This doesn't affect jump distance and height.
Added new finisher animations for Geralt.
Added new idle animations for Geralt.
Improved Geralt's ledge climbing, ladder climbing and vaulting animations as well as his speed for more responsive, fluid movement.
Improved Geralt's gap closing animations in combat for smoother gameplay.
Improved target-lock switching when moving the camera in combat.
Polished animations for mounting and dismounting Roach, as well as cantering and galloping.
Meditation now features a timelapse instead of a UI screen for a more immersive feel.
The skill screen is now reorganized into a more intuitive skill tree layout.
Updated the map screen to make switching between tracked quests easier. Untracked quests now have a distinct marker and can be tracked by selecting it.
You can now hide herbs, boats and corpses on the minimap in Settings → Video → Interface for a cleaner, less distracting view.
Improved quest notifications by combining quest updates into a single HUD notification.
Nearby loot can now be grouped into a single window, so you no longer need to browse through multiple loot windows. You can enable this feature in Settings → Gameplay.
Added a loot feed that displays recently collected items on the left side of the screen. You can disable it in Settings → Gameplay.

items.title: 《战神劳菲》特典灵感是贪玩蓝月？系兄弟就来砍我
items.summary: 《战神劳菲》特典灵感是贪玩蓝月？系兄弟就来砍我

content.v: 由你来说： 《战神：劳菲》预购特典已经公布，但如果一件外观让玩家第一眼想到的不是《战神》，而是“贪玩蓝月”，你还会愿意为了它提前预购吗？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282247465881.png
今日，随着《战神：劳菲》开启预购相关信息陆续公开，玩家社区开始讨论游戏的特典外观设计，其中部分玩家对造型风格颇有意见，甚至直接将其与国产传奇页游常见的夸张装备风格联系起来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282248255932.png
《战神：劳菲》此次预购奖励包括“最后愿望”护甲套装等内容，豪华版还会提供额外的护甲、武器和装备外观。官方希望通过这些内容为玩家提供更多角色定制选择，不过公布之后，部分贴吧玩家的第一反应并不是“帅”，而是觉得部分外观的配色、装饰和整体造型过于张扬。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282248279573.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282250311993.png
其中最有趣的吐槽就是“这是认真的吗？灵感来源于贪玩蓝月？”玩家认为，虽然《战神》系列本身并不排斥华丽装备，但这套特典外观如果放在传统欧美动作RPG语境里，似乎显得过于“堆料”，甚至有一种早年页游传奇装备的既视感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282247393590.png
当然，也有玩家并不排斥这种风格。有人认为特典本身就是额外的外观内容，不喜欢可以不用，而且《战神：劳菲》的世界观本身已经扩展到多个神话体系，与过去单纯的北欧神话风格有所不同，出现更加夸张的装备也并不奇怪。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282248423812.png
目前特典外观本身并不会影响核心玩法，真正决定玩家是否买单的还是游戏内容以及价格。那么你看到这套特典的第一反应是什么？史诗神话感，还是一股熟悉的“贪玩蓝月”味？

items.title: 买8元香菜仅退款 商家驱车500公里找上门：想出口气
items.summary: 据媒体报道，一名顾客花8元网购香菜，以香菜太老为由申请仅退款

content.v: 9月28日消息，据媒体报道，一名顾客花8元网购香菜，以香菜太老为由申请仅退款，商家朱先生驾车500多公里从徐州赶到对方家里要回香菜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282239496170.png
朱先生称，对方把香菜放冰箱了，看年纪大没有报警，只把菜要回来了，来回花费近千元，就是想出口气，希望平台能增设给顾客评分功能，让商家也有权利选择顾客。
这起事件引发热议，相关话题上了热搜榜。有网友替商家抱不平：贪这种小便宜很有意思吗？买家不满意可以退货，让商家付运费就可以了。
近年来，“仅退款”事件不再是新鲜事。在社交平台上搜索“仅退款”三个字，“愤怒的商家”和“被误伤”的买家时常在相关帖子下面“争执”，各说各的“理”。
业内人士认为，“仅退款”规则逐渐演变成“电商平台为争夺用户、追求极致体验而进行的‘内卷’”。大家都在想怎么留住用户，比拼谁的服务更极致、更主动”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282239599572.png
如果平台初步判断后，可替代商家作出“仅退款”的决定，无异于违背商家意愿，直接解除了买卖合同。“商家在这种情况下也是弱势，那谁来保护他们呢？”
虽然短期可以提升平台客户量，但长期来看难以抵偿商家撤出带来的负面影响。

items.title: 《战神劳菲》明日开预购：小道消息是真的？降价必买
items.summary: 《战神劳菲》明日开预购：小道消息是真的？降价必买

content.v: 由你来说： 《战神：劳菲》明天就要开启预购，如果港服价格真的降到378港币左右，玩家此前流传的“索尼低价区”是不是就要坐实了？随着索尼正式公布预购信息，同时公开全新的战斗系统与装备自定义内容，这款新作距离玩家真正掏钱已经只剩最后一步。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282236007957.jpg
索尼已确认，《战神：劳菲》将于北京时间9月29日上午10点开启海外预购，正式发售时间为2027年2月16日。游戏主角劳菲是奎托斯的亡妻和巨人族战士，故事将在她死后醒来、身处陌生国度的背景下展开。值得注意的是，尽管索尼此前宣布逐步淘汰实体光盘，本作仍将推出传统盒装版。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282237323889.png
预购奖励也已经公开。购买任意版本即可获得“最后愿望”护甲套装、“弗兰克金叶”外观以及游戏内资源包；数字豪华版则额外包含“黑暗炼金术”护甲、刀刃、蛇弓鳞片、催化剂，以及数字画册和原声带等内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282237393704.png
与此同时，圣莫尼卡工作室进一步公开了劳菲的核心战斗机制。相比奎托斯的利维坦之斧和混沌之刃，劳菲主要依赖可变形的蛇弓。它拥有精准射击和腰射两种模式，可以针对敌人弱点进行攻击，也能通过不同类型箭矢打出速射、爆炸和多目标效果。蛇弓还能够装备不同“蛇鳞”，利用被动能力改变战斗方向，并拥有独立技能树。
装备系统同样更加细化，护甲、剑刃、蛇弓鳞片和催化剂分别对应不同属性与能力，玩家可以按照自己的喜好打造劳菲的战斗风格。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282237021911.png
而玩家真正盯死的，依旧是港服价格。此前贴吧和B站社区不断出现相关暗示，有玩家猜测标准版可能定在378港币或398港币，原因则是近期《控制：共振》等作品在港服出现较低定价，让玩家开始期待索尼是否正在调整区域价格。目前这些数字仍然只是社区猜测，索尼尚未公布《战神：劳菲》的具体港服售价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282237525052.png
如果《战神：劳菲》真的以378港币左右登陆港服，你会直接预购，还是继续等索尼后续新作验证所谓的“低价区”？

items.title: 60岁王祖贤借AI"复出" 坦言大家还讨论她19岁的样貌
items.summary: 在隐退22年后，王祖贤近期因授权AI数字人重现巅峰形象与接受深度访谈重回大众视野

content.v: 在隐退22年后，王祖贤近期因授权AI数字人重现巅峰形象与接受深度访谈重回大众视野，但本人明确表示没有拍戏复出计划，引发了一轮关于情怀变现的热议。
本次回归由AI短片《倩影》和访谈共同组成，并非传统意义的拍戏复出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260928_zy_red_164_19/1108.jpg
王祖贤将20至30岁的巅峰肖像授权给网易端游《天下》IP，制作了全AIGC广告短片《倩影》，重现聂小倩等经典角色。王祖贤称这是“我们用AI，不是被AI用”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260928_zy_red_164_19/1191.jpg
同期接受了李诞的独家采访，这是她隐退22年来首个正式访谈，正面回应了息影原因和心境变化。她表示早在28岁拍完《青蛇》后就萌生退意，因为厌倦了演艺圈虚幻的光环和日夜颠倒、与世隔绝的生活，想寻找真实的自我，并非外界流传的“因情伤退圈”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260928_zy_red_164_19/1311.jpg
对于外界对她容貌变化的讨论，她在访谈中坦然表示“我已经60岁了，大家还在谈论我的容貌”，指出观众的记忆还停留在她19岁的银幕形象上。她表示过去害怕众人的目光，现在想明白了，“那些眼睛总有一天都会消失的”，因此不再畏惧露面。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260928_zy_red_164_19/1425.jpg

items.title: The Last Of Us Season 3 Adds John Goodman And Even More Actors From The Games
items.summary: HBO has announced further casting details for the upcoming third and possibly final season of The Last of Us.

content.v: HBO has announced further casting details for the upcoming third and possibly final season of The Last of Us.
Two actors from the games are set to appear in Season 3--Laura Bailey and Ian Alexander--along with prolific veteran actor John Goodman, as relayed by Deadline .
Bailey played Abby in Naughty Dog's The Last of Us: Part II, with Alexander portraying Lev. For the TV show, however, Kyriana Kratter is set to play Lev , while Kaitlyn Dever plays Abby.

Bailey will play Elizabeth, one of the Seraphite leaders, while Alexander will portray Paco, alongside Goodman as Joey. Joey and Paco are described as "Heroes of the Highway," but that's all we know. Goodman has worked with HBO before, starring on the comedy series The Righteous Gemstones.
Bailey's performance as Abby was memorable, and controversial. She received a lot of online hate, and people even sent death threats to her newborn baby .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-28-at-9.32.59-AM-1.png?w=636
Many actors from the games have been on the show
Bailey and Alexander are just the latest actors from the games to appear on the HBO show, following Merle Dandridge and Jeffrey Wright reprising their characters Marlene and Isaac, respectively.

Ashley Johnson, who played Ellie in the games, played Ellie's mom in Season 1. Troy Baker, who played Joel in the games, played James on the show. Jeffrey Pierce, who played Tommy in The Last of Us, appeared on the show as a new character, Perry.
Season 3 could be its last

HBO programming boss Casey Bloys has said on multiple occasions that he believes Season 3 could be the last one for The Last of Us. However, he's also acknowledged that the question might be better answered by showrunner Craig Mazin, who is plotting out the series and previously said he needed four seasons to wrap things up . Alternatively, Mazin is reportedly considering making Season 3 one long season as opposed to wrapping things up with Season 4.
A big creative shift

In a big shift for the series, franchise creator Naughty Dog is not involved creatively in Season 3 , and Neil Druckmann dropped out as a writer/director. People have speculated about what this could mean, but Druckmann, for his part, said he left the show to focus on his work on Naughty Dog’s games.
He is currently directing Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , and if it’s true that Naughty Dog is also making The Last of Us 3 , he’s probably involved in that, too.

items.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 Deliberately Moves Closer To Vanilla Minecraft
items.summary: Minecraft Dungeons 2 is taking a different approach to its relationship with vanilla Minecraft than its predec

content.v: Minecraft Dungeons 2 is taking a different approach to its relationship with vanilla Minecraft than its predecessor did. According to the game's developers, the sequel deliberately moves closer to the mechanics and feel of the original sandbox game, in part because the Dungeons franchise is now established enough to stand on its own two feet.

Speaking to GameSpot, Minecraft Dungeons 2 creative director Måns Olson and design director Laura de Llorens Garcia explained that the team deliberately pulled the sequel closer to vanilla Minecraft during development.

"As much as Dungeons 1 tried to interpret vanilla Minecraft--and I think we did a pretty good job of it--with some of the things that we had deviated from, we decided to take them even closer to vanilla," de Llorens Garcia said.

The sequel introduces several systems that will feel familiar to players of the original Minecraft game, including four armor slots, Enchantment Books, and jumping. "I think the fact that those systems now work that way makes it feel a lot closer to base game Minecraft," she added.
However, it wasn't simply a matter of making Dungeons 2 more similar to Minecraft. Olson explained that the team had a specific reason for taking a different approach with the sequel.

"When we made Minecraft Dungeons and we did the early testing of the game, when we asked players what they thought and what it reminded them of, there were a lot of players who said, 'This game reminds me of Minecraft PvP servers,' or, 'It reminds me of Story Mode.'"
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/1912410_20260922134734_1.png?w=636

Olson said that this was particularly important because many younger players had relatively little experience with games outside of Minecraft. As a result, the first Dungeons needed to establish its own identity first.

"In that world, it was very important that we made Minecraft Dungeons stand out--a game that didn't feel like the base game, that felt different enough to stand on its own legs and bring something new to the table," he explained. "'Cause otherwise it could have just been a mod, you know? It needed to be something of its own."
That led the team to make some pretty significant departures from vanilla Minecraft.
"So we made a Minecraft game without mining or crafting, which sounds silly, but that's how we went about it." Olson explained.

For Dungeons 2 though, the team felt it had more freedom to move back toward vanilla Minecraft because of that identity being established for the Dungeons brand. The developers see the sequel's larger, more interconnected world as another way of bringing it closer to the main game. Although Dungeons 2 isn't being positioned as an open-world game, the the exploration has been increased compared to its predecessor.
"We did push the world to be bigger and more exploratory in this game compared to the first game and that brings us closer to vanilla," Olson said.

That philosophy extends beyond Dungeons 2 itself, as the developers have been working closely with the vanilla Minecraft team while developing The Sift--the new dimension that is introduced in Dungeons 2, before coming to Minecraft in 2027 .

items.title: The Resident Evil Movie Wasn’t The Main Force Behind RE Games’ Recent Sales Boost
items.summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie has done big numbers at the box office since it hit theaters on September 1

content.v: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie has done big numbers at the box office since it hit theaters on September 18, but has that been reflected in increased Resident Evil game sales? According to new data, a set of fresh discounts prior to the movie's release did most of the heavy lifting for a surge in Resident Evil sales, and after the film landed, there was a "modest" bump in sales.

According to Alinea analyst Rhys Elliott, Capcom discounted several Resident Evil games on September 10 and kept those savings active after Cregger's movie arrived. "Almost all the copy movement was on PlayStation," Elliott wrote . "Resident Evil 2 nearly doubled on PS5 while doing just +16% on Steam, and Resident Evil 4 jumped +77% on PS5 versus a flat 0% on Steam. RE2 and RE4 picked up another 50-65% in PS5 copies even after you strip the discount out, which makes sense: they have a mix of nostalgia, quality, and the exact Raccoon City setting the film runs around in. On Steam, the same movie effect is a much milder +11% to +14%."

As Elliott noted, the older Resident Evil games currently cost much less than Capcom charged when they first went on sale, while the latest game in the series, Resident Evil Requiem, got a 30% discount and was $49 this month before its price went back up to $70. Overall, there was higher engagement across the entire series, as the film reactivated an existing fanbase of players who already owned Resident Evil games.

"The movie tells an original story with a new lead, so newcomers have no obvious game to jump into," Elliott wrote. "The horror-film audience and the horror-game audience overlap heavily. Cregger is a draw in his own right after Barbarian and Weapons. An opportunity is next year's Resident Evil Veronica, which already has almost 2 million Steam wishlists. It stars Claire Redfield and, if it follows the original timeline, is set three months after Raccoon City, the event the film is built around. If the streaming release is timed to Veronica's launch, Capcom and Sony could finally build the on-ramp that most transmedia projects are missing. Still, transmedia stuff isn't having the impact it could."

In its second week at the box office, Resident Evil was dethroned by the Avengers. Ahead of the release of Avengers: Doomsday, Disney brought Avengers: Endgame back to theaters, taking first place with a North American box office haul of $26 million for the re-release. Resident Evil dropped to second place, but overall, the movie is still doing impressive numbers.

After an opening weekend that surpassed expectations , Resident Evil has now made over $196 million at the global box office. That makes it the fourth highest-grossing live-action Resident Evil movie so far, but it still has a way to go before it dethrones the current king of that list, 2016's Resident Evil: The Final Chapter and its $312 million box office gross. Cregger's film has received critical acclaim since launch-- even if people were iffy on its ending --and on GameSpot’s Sister site, Metacritic, the movie has a metascore of 79 from 51 reviews.

“By backing away from the stories and characters of the video games, Cregger dodges the giant bullet of ‘that’s not my Leon Kennedy’ and instead lets us finally experience Resident Evil ourselves, through our own eyes,” Eric Frederiksen wrote in GameSpot’s Resident Evil movie review .

蛇弓介绍
这把附魔弓拥有蛇形形态，是菲在永恒世界中的新武器。它能以闪电般的速度从休眠状态变为蓄力状态，使她能够在其他攻击之外，施展致命的箭矢攻击。正如其名，蛇弓拥有致命的撕咬能力，无论近战还是远程战斗，都能撕裂菲的敌人。
完全按下瞄准扳机，菲伊就能更精准地瞄准，并增加攻击距离。攻击敌人身体的特定部位，可以削弱他们的行动能力或攻击能力，从而为她创造绝佳的近战攻击机会。
在瞄准模式下，菲可以蓄力弓箭，最多可以堆叠五支箭进行强力齐射——非常适合利用弗兰克将敌人击飞到空中的能力。

蛇弓的快速射击风格让菲伊能够轻松应对空中敌人，并在武器和技能之间无缝切换，从而延长连击。
选择你的箭矢
除了两种射击模式外，菲伊还可以使用多种箭矢类型，进一步丰富你的游戏风格。速射、爆炸、多目标攻击——菲伊的弓箭是一种多功能武器，能够创造并抓住敌人的破绽。
蛇鳞
脱去一种形态，拥抱另一种形态——蛇弓可以装备不同类型的鳞片，这不仅会改变武器的外观，还会通过独特的特性改变其擅长的游戏风格（例如数字豪华版中的黑暗炼金术弓鳞片）。
除了装备的鳞片之外，蛇弓还有可解锁的技能，可以让菲进一步扩展其功能。
Expressive Power
菲是一位身手不凡的战士，能够运用多种技能掌控战局。
她的盔甲选项将允许你选择一系列游戏特性、属性和独特外观。你还可以自定义她的其他装备，以进一步强化不同的游戏风格：

鳞片——菲伊的蛇弓的可定制元素
催化剂——这些强大的神器能够引导永恒之境的强大魔法，菲可以从各种具有不同效果的催化剂中进行选择。

9月28日，王楚钦0比4不敌队友林诗栋，后者获得爱知·名古屋亚运会乒乓球男单冠军。
身为国乒男队队长，王楚钦为林诗栋感到高兴，“从之前的混双决赛到今天的男单决赛，林诗栋一路战胜了许多优秀的选手，尤其是在男单半决赛，他也打得特别艰难，我觉得他这一次（亚运会）突破了自己之前低迷的状态，这是中国乒乓球队值得高兴的一件事情。”

items.title: 3 战锤 40,000 名病态者分享了他们最坚定的信念——你可以对他们投票
items.summary: Fraser, Jody, and Sean take a stand.

content.v: Warhammer 40,000! It's absolutely everywhere. You can't leave the house without almost stepping on an ork (which hurts even worse than stepping on Lego) these days. It's on your table, in your book shops, even on the TV, but the place you're most likely to encounter 40k is on your PC.

Since PC Gamer is, humbly, the global authority on PC games, we naturally have some thoughts on 40k. So I've gathered my fellow 40k freaks, Jody and Sean, to share our strongest held beliefs about Warhammer 40,000 and its PC game adaptations. And you can express your agreement or outrage by voting "good and pure" or "heretical" underneath each opinion.
Warhammer 40k is silly but the videogames take it way too seriously
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HemKwoe7mH2jt3xmynQudk-1920-80.jpg

Warhammer is deeply rooted in satire and parody. It's incredibly silly. This might be a touch more overt in the fantasy universe, but 40k certainly isn't meant to be taken seriously. We are talking about a setting where humanity is ruled by the corpse of psychic Jesus, and where space fascists fight space elves and frequently annihilate entire planets.
It is incredibly, wonderfully dumb.

But often it's presented with a straight face. It can sometimes seem like we're meant to just find all this edgelord stuff incredibly cool, rather enjoying it for the absurdity. And this has largely been promoted by Games Workshop, but I would love for the adaptations to embrace this seemingly forgotten side of 40k—to acknowledge the silliness or use the setting to say something, to dig back down to its satirical roots, even if it's just so we can have a good laugh. I mean, c'mon, the first ever inquisitor depicted in 40k was called Obiwan Sherlock Clousseau .
The Space Marine games kinda suck
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nZQbCP69rRhsnBZVge4Kch-1920-80.jpg

When my former colleague Robin Valentine gave Space Marine 2 a score of 60% in his review last year, he got a lot of shit for it. Allow me to humbly offer an alternative perspective: he was actually incredibly generous.

I will never understand the love for either Space Marine game—because they're bad. Sure, they look great, perfectly capturing both the 40k aesthetic and the hefty feel of the tank-like Space Marines. But they are a chore to play. With the campaigns being as short and linear as they are, there's just no excuse for the endless repetition. It turns out there is a limit to how many times you can execute a tyranid or an ork before it becomes rote. If you've played either game for 30 minutes, you've seen everything.

These are dreary, po-faced games that, in a sane universe, would at best be considered briefly fun diversions that never actually go anywhere. And it's wild to see Wolverine—the punching bag of the moment—getting so much flak for being only a bit more rudimentary than Space Marine 2, a game that is inexplicably loved.
We need more 40k RPGs and fewer strategy games
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/466vQ5MUVZtrfprG6LfG7g-1920-80.jpg

Please put down the lasguns. Look, I'm a strategy boy. I love Dawn of War, I love Mechanicus, and Total War: Warhammer 40k looks like it might be the best thing Creative Assembly has ever made. I don't want any of them to go away. But I have played so many 40k strategy games, both on my PC and my tabletop. Now I want something different.
I blame the Black Library. I only started reading 40k novels a few years ago, but nearly every book has made me think, "Damn, this would be a cool RPG." Not a strategy game.

Rogue Trader may have been rough at launch, but after putting around 150 hours into it since then, I can safely say that it's one of my favourite CRPGs. Thank goodness Dark Heresy is on its way. But being the greedy lad that I am, I want more! 40k may have started as a strategy game, but it's the setting that's given it this incredible staying power, and an RPG might just be the best way to experience it.
Games Workshop needs to give Wolf Guard Terminators their thunder hammers back
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Z3iJc4QkJ7oNBcwbP2bYJf-1920-80.jpg

My Wolf Guard Terminators are my pride and joy. My big, burly vikings stride into battle with thunder hammers and storm shields, and have done for years. But no more. Thunder hammers are out. The new WGT models might as well be a completely different unit, and my OG termies are now heretical. And I know what Games Workshop is planning: "We'll just sell them Wolf Guard Assault Terminators later and they'll lap it all up." It suuuuucks. Just give us back our thunder hammers, you dorks.
We need more 30k videogames
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WYbw3jprKb95YB8HUcCMD7-1920-80.jpg

If 40k is the depressing state of the Imperium after enlightenment went to shit, 30k is the powder keg moment that set it on that irrevocable course. Despite the book bloat, the Horus Heresy is such a fascinating period, like watching a car crash in slow motion as the Emperor's meticulously laid plans collide with the unrestrained ambitions of the Primarchs.

There's something so 'original sin' about the heresy, such a sense of grief as you witness what was lost forever for the sake of arrogance. 30k is also a period between periods. Unlike 40k, where most of the Imperium's xenos have been eradicated, the Great Crusade has humanity encountering (albeit murdering) all sorts of weird and wonderful aliens as it tries to unite the disparate human worlds cut off during old night.

It's just such a bloody good story, and frankly, perfect fodder for any number of videogame adaptations. It's the boiling point of thousands of years of human ambition coming to a head, but also hints of a distant past you rarely get to witness in 40k games. Shadowy cabals of now extinct xenos, Perpetuals, Thunder Warriors, where the Emperor came from; how the Imperium came to be and what it was like before eternal war overtook the galaxy.
The first Warhammer 40k TV show should be Gaunt's Ghosts, not Eisenhorn
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Rn9KaKuqrWhsyEDjUpMEQ4-1920-80.jpg

There's been all sorts of buzz the past few years about Henry Cavill's 40k TV show with Amazon. I'm cautiously optimistic. 40k is a tough setting to adapt, but if done right , this could lead to a veritable renaissance of grimdark media where we see many of our favorite Black Library books adapted for TV—the audience is certainly there.

And speaking of favorite series, most people are convinced Eisenhorn should be first, but I think Gaunt's Ghosts would make for a far better TV show. I love the Eisenhorn books, particularly the follow-up Ravenor series, and like most fans, I'm still reeling from the cliffhanger at the end of Penitent as I anxiously await Dan Abnett getting time to write the third book in the Bequin trilogy.

Eisenhorn is a great little bit of sci-fi noir, as the eponymous inquisitor travels across the Imperium with his band of operators, but by comparison, Gaunt's Ghosts and its story of the Tanith regiment is far more human and relatable, and also fits the whole 'death march' structure that's become so popular in modern TV.

I'm not the first to point out Gaunt's Ghosts is effectively Sharpe set in 40k (as someone who's read all of both I can tell you it's an apt comparison), and the Sharpe books already made for an excellent TV series back in the '90s with Sean Bean. Gaunt's Ghosts has some properly fantastic twists and turns, intimate character moments, but also more action than Eisenhorn, especially in terms of big battles, which are a vital part of 40k—it's the perfect TV show package.

items.title: PS玩家好日子来了？传游戏降价 港服点卡也跳水
items.summary: 贴吧上突然炸出一堆帖子——“71折！71折！71折！点卡大跳水了这是？”

content.v: 由你来说： 贴吧上突然炸出一堆帖子——“71折！71折！71折！点卡大跳水了这是？”点进一看，500港币面值的PSN点卡，淘宝和闲鱼上已经跌破360元人民币，相当于7折出头。 你认为这波降价的原因是什么？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282124339780.png
近日，贴吧玩家社区涌现大量关于PS港服点卡降价的讨论帖。据玩家反馈，500港币面值的PSN点卡在第三方平台已跌破360元，部分商家甚至挂出355元的价格，相当于原价的71折左右。此前PS港服点卡的正常折扣长期稳定在80折到85折之间，这波降价幅度明显超出常规。
有玩家指出，这波降价可能与近期港币汇率波动、以及第三方商家之间的价格竞争有关。值得注意的是，索尼互动娱乐此前已宣布将在2028年1月停止生产PlayStation新作实体光盘，数字版游戏的购买需求正在持续走高。

“《巫师3：狂猎重制版》是一款出色的终极版，它远远超出了简单提升分辨率的范畴，为这款传奇RPG注入了新的活力。所有视觉效果的全面升级、新增技术以及生活质量方面的改进，都为这段最初于十多年前问世的游戏体验带来了巨大的价值。除了官方加入的模组内容相对有限之外，这次免费更新依然是一场不容错过、制作精良而且美轮美奂的冒险，无论是首次接触游戏的新玩家，还是回归的老玩家都一样如此。”

items.title: 传《GTA6》之后R星将开发《黑色洛城2》 2030年发售
items.summary: 有爆料称，R星计划在《GTA6》之后开发《黑色洛城》续作，目标2030年推出。目前工作重心仍在《侠盗猎车手6》的Rockstar Games，尚未公布这款续作。R星目前正全力开发备受期待的《GTA6》。然而，许多粉丝已经

content.v: 有爆料称，R星计划在《GTA6》之后开发《 黑色洛城 》续作，目标2030年推出。目前工作重心仍在《侠盗猎车手6》的Rockstar Games，尚未公布这款续作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790600092_783257_jpg_r.jpg
R星目前正全力开发备受期待的《GTA6》。然而，许多粉丝已经开始好奇该工作室的下一个项目会是什么样子。 看来R星在《GTA6》之后可能会推出一款规模较小的游戏，早前的泄露信息表明，《黑色洛城》的续作计划于2030年发售。
和GTAForums用户Shahanshah的爆料一致，此次泄露来自一位4chan用户，他爆料了《黑色洛城2》游戏的初步细节。据报道，该游戏以旧金山为背景，讲述了著名的十二宫杀手故事。R星还计划在《黑色洛城2》这不续作中改进其面部捕捉技术MotionScan，力求打造“有史以来画面最好的游戏”。
这位神秘的4chan爆料者之所以受到重视，是因为他在2023年准确地描述了《GTA6》的各种机制，例如人际关系和犯罪侧写系统，以及它们对游戏故事的影响。
他还提到，《GTA6》最初计划有四位主角，罗布·尼尔森在最近的预览中也证实了这一点。因此，粉丝们现在开始关注这款2023年《黑色洛城》续作的泄露消息，而这似乎也得到了其他多方面的证实。
今年早些时候Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick暗示将推出新的《黑色洛城》续作，当被问及这款游戏时，他表示公司未来的目标是利用其所有IP做一些事情。
2020年，一部据称是《黑色洛城》续集的电影原声带意外上传到油管，并带有《黑色洛城第二部》的标签，但很快就被Take-Two删除。
最后，R星最近收购了原《黑色洛城》团队，也就是现在的R星澳大利亚。因此，多年来的种种联系表明，《黑色洛城》续作或许真的正在开发中，并计划于2030年发售。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《战神：劳菲》全新实机 多功能蛇弓 超强装备自定义
items.summary: 圣莫尼卡工作室正式公布了《战神：劳菲》的战斗系统细节

content.v: 圣莫尼卡工作室正式公布了《战神：劳菲》的战斗系统细节。作为奎托斯的亡妻、巨人族战士劳菲，她的战斗风格与奎托斯的利维坦之斧和混沌之刃截然不同，核心围绕一把可变形附魔弓——蛇弓（Serpent Bow）展开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282047092817.png
蛇弓拥有两种截然不同的射击模式。精准模式下，玩家完全按下瞄准扳机，劳菲将进入精确瞄准状态，拉弓距离更远，可击中敌人身体的特定部位。命中这些部位能削弱敌人的移动能力或攻击能力，为后续近战连击创造破绽。在此模式下，劳菲可蓄力叠加最多五支箭，对浮空敌人发动强力齐射。
腰射模式则只需半按瞄准扳机，劳菲进入更灵活的移动射击姿态，可在近距离释放密集箭雨，造成爆发伤害。蛇弓的速射特性让劳菲能在空中连续打击敌人、延长连段，并在武器与技能之间无缝切换。
除两种射击模式外，劳菲可使用多种箭矢类型来深化战斗风格——速射、爆炸、多目标，每种箭矢都能创造并利用不同的战斗窗口。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/origin_202609282048231202.gif
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/origin_202609282048304091.gif
蛇弓还可装备不同类型的蛇鳞（Scales），这些鳞片不仅改变武器外观，还通过独特的被动效果改变蛇弓的专精方向。数字豪华版中包含的“黑暗炼金术弓鳞”即是其中一种。此外，蛇弓拥有可解锁技能树，进一步扩展其战斗能力。
劳菲的装备自定义分为四个维度。护甲提供不同的玩法加成、属性和外观；刀刃可自定义剑的元素属性；鳞片可自定义蛇弓的元素属性；催化剂则是能引导“永时”魔法的强力神器，劳菲可从多种不同效果的催化剂中选择。这套系统让玩家能根据自身偏好，灵活构建劳菲的战斗风格。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282050583312.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282050584369.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282051001250.png
《战神：劳菲》将于2027年2月16日登陆PS5，预购于9月29日开启。

items.title: PS5模拟器SharpEmu已在17款游戏中实现可玩 其中8款以60帧运行
items.summary: 实验性PS5模拟器SharpEmu更新了游戏兼容列表：目前有17款游戏可进入游玩环节，其中8款被列为“可玩”。这份名单较开发者此前公布的测试结果有所扩大。名单以独立游戏和复古风格作品为主。 开发者Scarecrow此前表

content.v: 实验性PS5模拟器SharpEmu更新了游戏兼容列表：目前有17款游戏可进入游玩环节，其中8款被列为“可玩”。这份名单较开发者此前公布的测试结果有所扩大。名单以独立游戏和复古风格作品为主。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790598877_333752.jpg
开发者Scarecrow此前表示，在已测试的55款游戏中，有12款能进入游玩环节，其中6款可达到60帧。这一数据随9月25日推出的v0.0.4-release.2版本公布；此后，兼容页面将可进入游玩的游戏数量更新为17款。
列为“可玩”的8款游戏分别是：
《雷神之锤》
《毁灭战士1+毁灭战士2》
《恶魔城：多米纳斯合集（Castlevania Dominus Collection）》
《死亡细胞》
《莎拉的梦中冒险》
《真空饲育箱》
《New Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja》
《古墓丽影4-6复刻版》
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790598879_726211_jpg_r.jpg
开发者同时说明，这些游戏均未完成从开头到结尾的测试，运行时仍可能出现轻微画面或音频问题。因此，兼容列表中的“可玩”尚不代表已验证完整流程。
另一款PS5模拟器KytyPS5曾让PS5版《给他爱5》在Ryzen 9 9950X3D和Radeon RX 7900 XT配置上达到最高60帧，但运行几分钟后便崩溃。它还成功运行了Astro's Playroom，并在《恶魔之魂：重制版》的测试中展现了不错的进展，帧数成功达到50帧。
SharpEmu表示，它优先考虑的是准确性和基础架构，而非特定游戏的兼容性，而KytyPS5则表示，它的目标是更广泛的兼容性和启动稳定性。这或许可以部分解释两者进展上的差距，但情况随时可能发生变化。尽管如此，在如此短的时间内看到模拟器领域取得如此巨大的进步，仍然令人欣喜。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

The Standard Edition will be available in both physical and digital formats, but the Deluxe Edition will be a digital exclusive. Pricing hasn't been revealed yet, but Sony typically charges $70 for a regular version of its game and $80 for a deluxe edition. We'll update this post as soon as the official prices are live.
Here's a closer look at what you get with each one.
God of War Laufey: Standard Edition
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Laufey-2.jpg?w=636

Preorder bonuses for the Standard Edition include a spiffy new "Last Wish" armor set for Faye, an elegant collection of golden leaves for Phranque the Cube to wear, and a pack of resources to help you get some early upgrades in.
God of War Laufey: Digital Deluxe Edition
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Laufey-1.jpg?w=636

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes all the aforementioned preorder bonuses, as well as an arsenal of "Dark Alchemy" weapon skins and a matching suit of armor for Faye to don. Additionally, you can check out the game's artwork and listen to its soundtrack.

Developer Sony Santa Monica also revealed a new weapon that Faye can wield: the Serpent Bow. An enchanted weapon, it can unleash a volley of arrows quickly, or you can hold down the aim trigger to unleash a precision bolt that also strikes from a longer range. If an enemy is hit with one of these arrows, their movement or ability to strike will be impaired, and Faye can follow up with melee attacks. You can even choose between rapid-fire, explosive detonations and multi-target arrows, making the Serpent Bow a versatile tool in battle.

God of War fans can expect even more from the franchise in the future, as a new Kratos-led game is coming after it that picks up where Laufey left off . A live-action TV series is also in development for Prime Video, and while actor Ryan Hurst is no longer playing the lead role due to an on-set injury, former WWE star Dave Bautista has stepped in to take over the part .

items.title: 摔角圈再传噩耗！AEW传奇明星PAC离世：年仅40岁
items.summary: 摔角圈再传噩耗！AEW传奇明星PAC离世:年仅40岁

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282006567019.png
职业摔角界近日传来噩耗，AEW官方确认，知名英国摔角手本杰明·萨特利（Benjamin Satterley），也就是曾以PAC、Neville等名字参赛的选手，于40岁时离世。AEW在9月28日凌晨发布声明，对其家人、朋友及长期支持他的粉丝表示哀悼。目前官方尚未公布死因。
令人唏嘘的是，PAC离世前一天才刚刚参加AEW年度大型赛事《All Out》。9月26日，他与老对手Andrade El Idolo进行比赛，虽然最终落败，但之后仍在主赛Will Ospreay对阵Jon Moxley的比赛期间再次登场。没想到，这竟成为他最后一次公开摔角活动。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282007216290.png
PAC来自英国纽卡斯尔，自2004年开始职业摔角生涯，曾征战WWE、新日本职业摔角、Dragon Gate等多个联盟，以极具爆发力的高空动作和出色的擂台表现闻名。他曾以Neville之名成为WWE NXT冠军，并在2019年加入AEW，成为联盟早期的重要选手之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282007128078.png
消息传出后，全球摔角界纷纷发文悼念。AEW世界冠军Will Ospreay称PAC是英国最杰出的摔角出口之一，也是自己眼中非常重要的人；AEW老板Tony Khan则称赞他的运动能力、职业态度与稳定表现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282010186185.jpg
值得一提的是，PAC的离世距离好友、AEW摔角手Andy Williams（The Butcher）去世仅约两周。两人此前曾多次并肩参赛，关系深厚。就在9月27日，Williams的追思活动举行期间，不少摔角从业者与观众得知PAC离世的消息。

content.v: 随着《巫师3：重制版》即将在明天发售，外媒GameSpot对比了PC重制版和原版游戏的画面效果。
具体来说，GameSpot将5.00版本与最新版本（4.04）进行了对比。所有版本均在4K分辨率、最高画质设置下运行，所有特效均已开启。
4.04版本开启了光线追踪，而5.00版本则同时开启了光线追踪和路径追踪。路径追踪是《巫师3：重制版》独有新功能，因此无法在4.04版本中启用它。
对比使用的是发售前版本。CD Projekt Red表示，其中可能存在一些轻微的画面问题，开发团队会继续处理直至游戏发售。因此，当前视频和截图中的画面仍可能变化。
《 巫师3：狂猎 》重制版即将于9月29日发售，登陆PC、PS5、Xbox Series X|S和Switch 2。老玩家升级至重制版无需额外付费。

items.title: 75岁张纪中与小31岁的老婆：还想生孩子 越生越聪明
items.summary: 75岁中国名导张纪中与44岁妻子杜星霖近日在直播中透露，夫妻俩有意继续“拼一胎”

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282004455919.png
75岁中国名导张纪中与44岁妻子杜星霖近日在直播中透露，夫妻俩有意继续“拼一胎”，引发网友热议。杜星霖在直播中谈及孩子时难掩喜爱，形容家中孩子“越生越聪明、越生越可爱”，张纪中则坐在一旁微笑看着镜头。有报道指出，杜星霖还提到希望再添一名男孩，与小女儿“小龙珠”作伴。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282004548220.png
张纪中曾制作《笑傲江湖》《天龙八部》等多部金庸武侠剧，一生经历三段婚姻。他与第一任妻子王玎育有一女，之后与女导演樊馨蔓再婚，最终离婚。2017年，他与原为助理的杜星霖登记结婚，两人相差31岁，婚姻多年来备受关注。婚后夫妻俩陆续迎来一子两女，最小的女儿“小龙珠”于2024年出生；加上杜星霖婚前通过试管生下的儿子马丁，一家六口生活热闹。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609282004553061.png
2024年小女儿出生时，张纪中曾公开向女儿喊话，感谢她来到这个家庭。如今夫妻俩再度公开谈及生育计划，让这段相差31岁的婚姻以及这个大家庭是否会再添新成员，再次成为话题。

items.title: Review: RuneScape: Dragonwilds (Switch 2) - A Slow-Burn Survival-Crafting RPG That Underwhelms Visually
items.summary: Phr33 st00f pl0x. A few years ago when I tried Old School RuneScape for the first time, I spent hours putterin

content.v: Phr33 st00f pl0x.

A few years ago when I tried Old School RuneScape for the first time, I spent hours puttering around the starting area taking on basic quests, chopping down trees, and slaying goblins in the surrounding wilds. After each lengthy session, I would exit the game, lean back in my chair with a contented smile, and realise that I had accomplished essentially nothing of note.

This is the quintessential RuneScape experience: an MMO so expansive and storied that you could easily drop hundreds of hours into it without seeing or doing half of what’s available. The goal isn’t so much to progress as it is to simply exist in the game’s fantasy world, engaging in activities both exciting and mundane that slowly but surely add up and strengthen your character’s abilities. Put otherwise, the grind is kind of the point.

items.title: DLSS 5太夸张了！《地平线6》座舱视角像真人驾驶
items.summary: DLSS 5太夸张了！《地平线6》座舱视角像真人驾驶

content.v: 近日，一段《极限竞速：地平线6》的画面演示在海外社区引发关注。视频由创作者ModFrames制作，展示了开启DLSS 5 Ultra后的4K游戏画面，其中最吸引眼球的是车辆座舱视角。经过超高分辨率与AI画面技术加持，方向盘、仪表台以及挡风玻璃外的环境都呈现出非常细腻的光影效果，整体观感甚至被部分玩家形容为“像真实驾驶画面”。
视频欣赏：
从视频来看，座舱内部的材质表现尤为突出，金属、皮革以及玻璃反光都更加明显，配合车辆行驶过程中不断变化的光照，让传统赛车游戏中的“驾驶室镜头”拥有更强的临场感。尤其是在4K分辨率下，画面细节被进一步放大后，车辆内部原本容易被忽略的纹理也变得清晰可见。
这段视频也再次引发玩家对DLSS 5画面表现的讨论。玩家认为，AI重建和光影处理能够让赛车游戏更接近真实摄影效果，尤其适合《地平线》这种强调风景与车辆细节的作品；但也有玩家认为，超强的真实感并不一定意味着更好的游戏画面，一些人更喜欢保留传统游戏的艺术风格。

items.title: 《魔兽争霸3》新DLC获IGN 7分：更像RPG而非RTS
items.summary: 《魔兽争霸3：重制版》资料片“被遗忘者王国”评测

content.v: 《魔兽争霸3：重制版》资料片“被遗忘者王国”是2026年推出的全新单人战役扩展，距《冰封王座》已过去23年。故事从阿尔萨斯弑父归来、天灾军团席卷洛丹伦的那一天讲起：守卫中尉加雷克·班达里昂在安多哈尔与斯坦索姆的沦陷中奋力挣扎，最终被复活为拥有自由意志的被遗忘者，转而追随希尔瓦娜斯，在幽暗城地下建立自己的王国。本次更新还包含首位新中立英雄“被遗忘者圣骑士”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281953392171.png
简评：
《被遗忘者王国》是一次令人惊喜的回归。战役延续了经典《魔兽争霸3》的叙事质感，并大胆融入更深的RPG装备与等级机制；新画风在多人对战中几乎完美复刻了原版记忆，新英雄也让天梯重新活跃。可惜RTS关卡偏少、Definitive画质不适用于旧战役，整体仍是一部有诚意但不够完整的扩展。对老玩家而言，值得一玩。
IGN评分： 7 分
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281952283626.png
总评：

任务序章《洛丹伦的最后日子》设计扎实，安多哈尔围城战加入类似MOBA的占塔刷兵机制，斯坦索姆则变成双线地牢探索，需协调加雷克与精灵牧师伊拉斯塔两队。主线中加雷克被复活后，战役转为自由探索、任务驱动的RPG模式，等级上限20，并引入类似《魔兽世界》的装备槽系统。问题在于：除序章外几乎只有一关真正用上RTS机制；常规部队只能从雇佣兵营地购买，金钱与装备升级冲突，导致玩家基本只靠两名英雄平推；死亡守卫等新单位过于脆弱，英雄又能免费复活，进一步削弱了战术深度。剧情虽不惊艳，却有老暴雪式的粗粝感，幽暗城视角、血色十字军崛起以及加雷克成为首位被遗忘者圣骑士的情感落点都值得肯定。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281953549244.png
新画风近距离过场时纹理扁平、像素明显，观感欠佳；但一旦进入快速缩放的对战，几乎让人忘记这是2026年的游戏——单位与建筑高度还原2003年记忆，只是更清晰。遗憾的是，该画质仅限“被遗忘者王国”战役、多人及自定义游戏，经典《混乱之治》与《冰封王座》战役仍只支持经典/Reforged，这是本次更新最令人失望的分配不均。
被遗忘者圣骑士作为亡灵中立英雄，只能治疗活物，对亡灵玩家反而最不实用。Q冲刺减速、W类似奉献（伤害亡灵、治疗活物）、被动减魔法伤并增疗、大招AoE净化眩晕兼治疗。玩法有趣，可能略超模。控制组单位数量翻倍，对老派玩家或有争议，但整体是积极改动。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281954033572.png
等待多年后，《被遗忘者王国》虽未达到《混乱之治》或《冰封王座》的高度，却成功找回经典手感，并用更深的RPG机制和贴合时代的叙事留住玩家。加雷克的故事值得走完，新画风值得体验，新英雄值得研究——只希望下次，经典战役也能享受同等待遇。

items.title: CD Projekt 发布《巫师 3：狂猎 - 重制版》所有改进的官方列表
items.summary: CD Projekt has released an official list of all the improvements made for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastere

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/tw3re-gamescom-blood-and-wine-1-xbox-16x9-clean-1790595861472.png
CD Projekt has released an official list of all the improvements made for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered .

The developer issued media with the updated list, which breaks the improvements down into four categories: visual, combat, quality of life, and miscellaneous. We’ve reproduced them below so you know what to expect when the game launches tomorrow, September 29.

We’ve also got the official The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered global release times , so you know when the game unlocks in your region, as well as the update download sizes so you can best prepare.

“A lot has changed in the gaming world since The Witcher 3 first launched,” CD Projekt said in its note to the media. “We’ve continued to develop and improve the game over the years, with the last major update bringing the title to next-gen consoles. Never before, however, have we introduced so many extensive, far-reaching changes at once — Remastered is the first release of its kind for The Witcher 3.

“These changes affect every aspect of the game, with particular attention to exploration and combat mechanics. We’ve significantly improved a wide range of gameplay elements. Some features, such as the skill tree, have even been entirely rebuilt to ensure the best possible experience for both new and returning players. Whether this is your first time visiting the Continent or a long-awaited return to the Path, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered was created with you in mind.”
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered improvements:
VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS

From the sun-drenched hills of Beauclair to the snow-capped mountains of Skellige, the Continent has never looked so stunning. The world of The Witcher 3 is now more detailed than ever thanks to a range of visual improvements, while modernized lighting lets every location truly shine.
COMBAT IMPROVEMENTS
Overhauled combat feels modern, engaging, and more responsive than ever, and the skill tree—the heart of every RPG — has been rebuilt to radically improve player experience.
QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS
Revamped movement animations, more engaging exploration, and a range of other gameplay enhancements make every adventure even more immersive than before.
MISCELLANEOUS IMPROVEMENTS

As part of Remastered, we’ve also introduced a range of other additions to The Witcher 3 that are worth highlighting. While they don’t fall under any one specific aspect of the game, they still represent significant additions to the overall experience.

As for the Nintendo Switch 2 version, CD Projekt pointed to motion controls, which let players cast witcher Signs, fire the crossbow, throw bombs, drink potions, and speed up or stop Roach. Gyro aiming "offers greater precision in combat," while mouse mode gives players another control option. The touchscreen can be used to navigate the map or game menus, and play Gwent.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered is available as a free update on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 from September 29. To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the Things the Witcher 3 Doesn’t Tell You , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 Walkthrough and The Witcher 3 Endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 Sex and Romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher Gear Locations , Places of Power Locations , and even Gwent Card Locations .

items.summary: World of Warcraft Forever’s beta marches on, and all evidence points to it being a massive success. But it’s w

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/wow-1790594365869.jpg

World of Warcraft Forever’s beta marches on, and all evidence points to it being a massive success ahead of the official release date next month. But it’s worth remembering this is a beta, and a beta is for players testing the game's boundaries and developer Blizzard reacting when those boundaries are broken.
Enter one of the best World of Warcraft griefing tactics I’ve seen in Forever so far.

Player jamesja12 took to the WoW Forever subreddit to post a screenshot of their death. That would be nothing worth writing home about under normal circumstances — you die all the time in World of Warcraft. But this was a screenshot of their character after they had died during the intro cinematic, because one cheeky player had placed a campfire exactly where new players spawn.

For the uninitiated, when you create a character in World of Warcraft — and World of Warcraft Forever — you get a snazzy intro cinematic that sets up the part of the world you start in, as well as your role within it. The camera does a fly-by of the local area before resting behind your freshly spawned character, ready to set out adventuring.

In WoW Forever you can craft and place campfires, which are — normally — all about helping other players out. Sit next to a campfire and you’ll receive a useful buff and maybe strike up a conversation with another player doing the same. Campfires are really cool social tools, as well as great buffing machines. I like campfires!

But they also cause a little damage because, well, they’re fire. If you run through a campfire, for example, you’ll take damage, as most WoW players will know well. Pop a campfire down where new characters spawn and they’ll strip that low HP away pretty quickly.

“Someone made a campfire where new players spawn. It killed me during the intro cinematic,” jamesja12 said, matter of factly, while posting a screenshot of the evidence of the crime scene. Pretty annoying? Well, most of the reaction is from players who are pretty impressed by this griefing tactic, rather than outraged.

“This is diabolical. I love it, although it's pretty mean,” one player said. “My orc was grunting during the intro and I had no idea why lol,” jamesja12 replied, referring to the noise characters make when they take damage.
“Brings new meaning to the term ‘spawn camping,’” another player said. “I can’t even be mad at that,” added another. “This is peak classic wow, amazing,” commented another.

This is World of Warcraft, so war between the Horde and the Alliance is part of the game. I was questing in Westfall last night as it was being raided by a high level Horde player who was killing quest-giving NPCs. Some were complaining in the chat, others saying this is part of the game. These are 20-year-old debates, rekindled once again in WoW Forever, and it’s great fun to see.

But this is orc-on-orc griefing, so perhaps Blizzard will take a dim view of it. I expect the developer will patch it out in some way — especially after this reddit post blew up (6,000 upvotes and counting!). I totally respect the effort to grief here. Yes, it’s annoying, but this is a beta after all. Best not to get too upset about anything. Now, if this becomes a widespread issue when Forever launches proper next month, that’s another thing. But for now… well done everyone! Jamesja12 indicated they used the in-game tool to report the “bug,” so it’s probably not long for this world. Enjoy it while it lasts.

The WoW Forever beta was inundated with players , and Blizzard has suggested its popularity took even the developers by surprise. It’s had to increase the beta population cap multiple times already. Yeah, this is going to be a big one.

items.title: McDonald's Happy Meal Pokémon Cards Promotion Launches in November
items.summary: Pokémon cards will return to McDonald's Happy Meals soon, with 15 more cards to collect.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/untitled-1-1790593229682.jpg
Pokémon cards will return to McDonald's Happy Meals soon, with 15 more cards to collect.
According to PokéBeach , branches of McDonald's in the U.S. will feature packs of cards in Happy Meals from November 5 to December 9 this year, meaning you have just a month to collect them all.
As with previous versions of this hugely-popular promotion, 15 cards will be on offer via individual four-card booster packs, each of which will feature three regular cards and one holo.

Currently, there's no word on which cards will be included. Past years have seen the promotional packs simply feature reprints of existing cards (albeit with an exclusive McDonald's logo). But there is some hope that this set will feature something a bit more special, too.

Fans are still waiting for the Pikachu card that launched in Japan last year via a similar McDonald's Happy Meal promotion. It features a cute design with Pikachu reaching across the table towards a burger and some vegetables. (Just don't ask what's in the burger patty, I guess?)

That said, it remains to be seen whether this card will make the leap over to U.S. shores. If you recall, last year's Japanese promotion resulted in mass scenes of food waste, with uneaten burgers dumped in the streets, as fans and scalpers hunted for the card, and others. The retail chain then promptly ended the giveaways early and introduced tighter rules to clamp down on Pokémon scalping for future promotions .
McDonald's is yet to confirm any of this promotion itself, though is expected to announce it and more details in the coming days.

items.summary: Anyone looking to play Gears of War: E-Day has several options for which platform they choose to get the game

content.v: Anyone looking to play Gears of War: E-Day has several options for which platform they choose to get the game on, and yes , Steam is one of them. While The Coalition's new entry in the Gears universe is exclusive to PC and Xbox Series X|S, PC owners can add Gears of War: E-Day to their Steam library. How does this differ from buying the game from the Xbox PC storefront or on console? Let's break it down.
Gears of War: E-Day PC price

Unsurprisingly, the Standard and Premium Editions of the game will cost you the same through Steam as it would through the official Xbox storefronts on PC and Xbox Series X|S, and it'll also be a day-one release for Xbox Game Pass subscribers. That works out to:
Gears of War: E-Day PC release date

For more detailed info on this, you can check out our Gears of War: E-Day Global launch times guide , but in a nutshell, the Steam version will unlock at the same time as the official Xbox versions. Owners of the Premium Edition can start playing early on October 1, while the Standard Edition unlocks on October 6. You can also check out our Gears of War: E-Day PC requirements guide to see if your rig can handle the visually impressive game.
Are there any Gears of War: E-Day preorder bonuses for Steam users?
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Gears-E-Day-bonuses.jpg?w=636
Preorder the game, and you'll unlock the Exfil Dom Character Skin and the Exfil Weapon Skin Set in-game at launch.
Is the Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition the same as the Xbox console and PC versions?
Yep, you'll get the exact same spread of digital goodies with this edition, which includes:
Is Gears of War: E-Day Steam Deck compatible?

Microsoft says that Gears of War: E-Day is "fully optimized" for various PC gaming handhelds like the Steam Deck and Xbox Ally X devices, but we haven't yet seen it in action. The Steam Deck uses three levels to indicate compatibility with games--Verified means it should run without a hitch out of the box, Playable means that it'll require some tweaking by the user, and Unsupported means that it won't function on the Steam Deck.
It's not yet known which category Gears of War: E-Day falls into, but Xbox Game Studios titles are usually playable on the Steam Deck handheld without needing much tinkering to perform optimally.
Are any of the other Gears of War games on Steam?

If you want to build a Gears of War collection in your Steam library, you can get some of the games through the Valve storefront. The big exceptions are Gears of War 2 and 3, as these have been console exclusives since their initial release, while Gears of War 4 remains missing in action. items.title: Fortnite Five Nights at Freddy's Announcement is Now the Game's Most Liked Reveal Ever, Beating the Avengers and Dragon Ball Z
items.summary: Epic Games' announcement of a Fortnite and Five Nights at Freddy's crossover has now become the battle royale'

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/6b17a3e0-26a6-4b99-a3a2-64aaf4c03d6f-1790591765592.jpg
Epic Games' announcement of a Fortnite and Five Nights at Freddy's crossover has now become the battle royale's most-liked post of all time on social media.

Characters from Scott Cawthon's hit horror series will join Fortnite next month, in time for its annual Halloween shenanigans. Among FNAF fans, the excitement is definitely real — and enough to dethrone the confirmation of similar crossovers with all other major franchises.

At the time of writing, Epic Games' confirmation of FNAF has more than 312,000 likes, making it the account's most-liked post ever: more than Dragon Ball Z (282,000 likes), Naruto (214,000 likes), and Avengers: Infinity War (212,000 likes, all the way back in 2018).
The post has even been liked more than Epic Games' own reveal it would be bringing back the game's original map for an "OG" mode (216,000 likes).

A trailer for the collaboration appears to confirm that Freddy, Chica, Bonnie and Foxy will all gain Fortnite skins, alongside various other cosmetic items. A Five Nights at Freddy's in-game location will also be featured — and indeed, this pizza restaurant can already be found being built on the battle royale's Island map, acting as a teaser for the collaboration.

FNAF has long been one of the most fan-requested Fortnite crossovers, with hopes, dreams and plenty of memes anticipating its eventual arrival over the years. Originally launched in 2014, FNAF has expanded from a simple Steam game into a major franchise, with numerous sequels, spinoffs, novels and two major Hollywood movies.

If you'd like to go hands-on with Freddy in Fortnite for yourself, the skins are expected to launch later this week on October 1, when the annual Fortnitemares celebration kicks off. This is set to run longer than usual — for a full month, and essentially until the end of this year's Fortnite chapter. Fans then expect another mini-season to take place, similar to last year's beloved Simpsons takeover (top bets this year include a similar One Piece event.) After that, Fortnite is expected to relaunch yet again with its Chapter 8 incarnation, likely around the start of December.

items.summary: 印度运动员批亚运会令人难过！狂赞23年杭州叹为观止

content.v: 据多家媒体媒体报道，印度羽毛球运动员普兰诺伊批评本届名古屋亚运会组织方对运动员的活动安排“令人难过”，并称与3年前在中国举行的杭州亚运会相比，本届赛事是一次退步。
报道称，普兰诺伊随队在本届爱知·名古屋亚运会上获得羽毛球项目男子团体赛事铜牌。他表示，由于缺乏专门的运动员村，运动员们失去了与其他参赛选手交流的乐趣，他们分散在不同的酒店、临时木屋和邮轮上。普兰诺伊表示，这对运动员来说是一次令人失望的经历。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281630143819.png
“这令人难过。”普兰诺伊在印度羽毛球协会26日发布的一段视频采访中说，他感觉大家根本没在参加亚运会，综合性运动会的乐趣和意义之一就在于可以结识其他运动员，有机会与他们互动，与他们交谈。
普兰诺伊说，身处这样的境地真的令人非常难过，“因为当你回顾2023年杭州亚运会时，中国的表现简直令人叹为观止。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281630249497.png
普兰诺伊表示，相比于他在中国杭州参加上一届亚运会的经历，本届亚运会逊色不少，“参加过中国举办的上一届亚运会后，你会期待三四年后情况会更好，但在这次赛事中，（情况）却倒退了。很多（运动员）在住宿和交通方面都遇到了困难。”普兰诺伊说，“说实话，这只是一场平庸的活动。”
普兰诺伊还批评了本届亚运会的羽毛球赛程安排，称参加单打比赛的选手一天要参加两场比赛，比平时多一场，“这很残酷”。
爱知·名古屋亚运会组委会没有立即回应有关普兰诺伊言论的置评请求。
此前，据爱知·名古屋亚运会官网26日消息，本届亚运会组委会事务总长村手聪就近期接连出现的赛事组织问题致歉。为压缩成本，本届赛事安排运动员居住在邮轮、集装箱房和各地酒店，住宿条件引发争议。赛会提供的交通保障也多次出现问题。针对此类后勤保障问题，村手说，赛事期间确实出现了一些差错，原因有多方面，“但无论是什么原因，提供这些服务都是组委会的责任，因此我要坦率地为这些失误道歉”。

items.title: 电子竞技项目退出亚运会！已失去主流体育体系认可？
items.summary: 2026年爱知·名古屋亚运会之后将电竞从亚运会项目中移出，并举办独立的亚洲电竞与智力运动会。

content.v: 编辑观点： 电竞从2026年爱知·名古屋亚运会之后退出亚运会，转而参加独立的“亚洲电竞与智力运动会”。脱离亚运会这个主流体育舞台，是给电竞松绑了，还是失去了最重要的认可？
电竞和传统综合性运动项目最大的区别，就是游戏版本、项目热度和厂商运营变化太快。亚运会四年一届，而一款游戏能不能活四年都不好说。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281830223634.png
过去某些电竞项目还出现过因为版权、版本以及项目调整等原因无法参赛的情况。2026年亚运会电竞就有11个奖牌项目、13款游戏，但像《DOTA2》等热门项目并未入选。
独立赛事至少可以在项目选择、赛制和时间安排上更加贴合电竞自身节奏。亚奥理事会早在2024年就已经正式决定，2026年爱知·名古屋亚运会之后将电竞从亚运会项目中移出，并举办独立的亚洲电竞与智力运动会。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281830414765.png
但亚运会的正式奖牌，对电竞的意义真的只是“一块金牌”吗？电竞进入亚运会之后，从2018年表演项目到2023年杭州亚运会正式奖牌项目，本身就是一次重要的社会认知变化。
如今亚奥理事会依然将电竞明确列为体育项目，并且官方定义中直接将电竞描述为结合玩家身体和心理能力进行竞技的体育项目。
所以玩家可能会产生一种很现实的担忧：以后电竞有了自己的亚洲赛事，专业性和自由度可能更高了，但普通大众看到亚运会里面却没有电竞了。对于不玩游戏的人来说，他们还会不会觉得电竞也是一种正式竞技项目？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281830536163.png
电竞到底需要什么？是一个可以让自己自由发展的专属舞台，还是一个能不断向圈外人证明电竞也是体育的大舞台？
如果独立赛事真的能让电竞少受项目、版本和赛制限制，你觉得这是电竞发展的机会，还是失去亚运会背书之后的一种退步 ？

items.title: 壕无人性！土豪用1200万定制24K纯金主机 散热比铝合金快50%
items.summary: 法国硬件厂商Kubb近日完成了一项壕无人性的私人订制任务，为一位黄金爱好者打造了纯24K金版本的Kubb Fanless迷你主机。这款奢华到极点的设备售价高达170万美元(约1195万元人民币)，其机箱完全由纯金铸造。据

content.v: 法国硬件厂商Kubb近日完成了一项壕无人性的私人订制任务，为一位黄金爱好者打造了纯24K金版本的Kubb Fanless迷你主机。
这款奢华到极点的设备售价高达170万美元(约1195万元人民币)，其机箱完全由纯金铸造。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790572708_193359.jpg
据了解，这款定制主机的初衷是利用黄金优秀的物理特性来提升散热表现。厂商声称由于采用了纯金被动散热机箱，其导热效率比标准的铝合金材质快了约30%至50%。
不过从物理学角度来看，黄金远非散热的最优解。公开数据显示，黄金的热导率约为314 W/mK，虽明显高于铝的205 W/mK，但银和铜的热导率分别高达406 W/mK和385 W/mK，均优于黄金。
而铜的价格更是远低于黄金，也就是说，若单纯追求散热效率，铜制机箱才是物美价廉的更佳选择。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790572708_233125.jpg
在硬件配置上，标准版Kubb Fanless可选英特尔酷睿Ultra 5 225H、酷睿Ultra X7 358H或AMD锐龙AI 5 340处理器，配备16GB DDR5内存(最高可选128GB)、1TB M.2 NVMe固态硬盘，并支持加装第二块M.2硬盘。
接口方面，英特尔版本提供1个USB 3.2 Type-A、1个USB 3.2 Type-C(DP 1.4a)、1个USB4/雷电4(DP 2.1)，支持Wi-Fi 7与蓝牙5.4。
AMD版本则配备1个USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A和2个USB4(DP 1.4a)，支持Wi-Fi 6与蓝牙5.3。
两款机型侧面均提供2个RJ45网口、2个HDMI 2.1接口及2个USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A接口，采用19V/6.32A、120W电源适配器，预装Windows 11 Pro系统，并提供3年质保。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 当牌组构建遇上塔防！《Tower Tactics 2》抢先体验将于10月8日开启
items.summary: 继数月前《Tower Tactics 2》Steam PC试玩版收获玩家热烈反响后，Assemble Entertainment宣布，本作将于2026年10月8日正式开启抢先体验。游戏将带来丰富的新特色、精彩的新要素与超

content.v: 继数月前《Tower Tactics 2》Steam PC试玩版收获玩家热烈反响后，Assemble Entertainment宣布，本作将于2026年10月8日正式开启抢先体验。游戏将带来丰富的新特色、精彩的新要素与超过80小时的海量内容!
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790590584_380892_png_r.webp
释放·防守·部署
作为大获好评的《Tower Tactics: Liberation》的正统续作，《Tower Tactics 2》将 Roguelike 牌组构建的策略深度与塔防的即时爽快感完美融合，打造出独一无二的战斗体验。本作的规模远超以往，极具挑战性的关卡设计更是让其在近期的同类作品中脱颖而出。
部署威力强大的防御塔，收集足以扭转战局的珍贵饰品，构筑牌组，释放威力极高的法术，为生存与胜利而战!全新的挑战就在前方!想从第4区的重重险境中存活下来?这可不是件容易的事，不过，你也将拥有更加强力的新手段来应对挑战。
Sal'koth的入侵再度威胁整个宇宙。在Kaya的指引下，新一代英雄将查明事件背后的真相，强化自身能力，在愈发凶险的遭遇战中杀出生天。随着任务不断推进，新能力逐一解锁，他们必须击败Sal'koth，最终找到拯救宇宙的方法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790590584_981289_png_r.webp
精益求精

开发者寄语：“在整个抢先体验期间，我计划加入更多的卡牌、饰品、敌人、内容与功能，同时根据玩家反馈对现有系统进行优化。游戏的核心玩法已经成型，但我希望能与大家携手，继续完善并扩充这款游戏。游戏内已有海量的防御塔、敌人、随机事件和多样玩法，还可以通过创意中心(Creative Hub)工具创造自定义内容，发布至Steam创意工坊与大家分享。在抢先体验上线时，游戏将包含基于任务驱动的故事线、丰富的通关后内容，以及主线冒险之外的4种游戏模式。《Tower Tactics 2》的抢先体验状态将预计持续1到2年时间。”
危机四伏的第四区
无穷无尽的敌人将不断冲击你的防线，把防御能力逼至极限，而你的每一个决定都可能改变战局。全新英雄、能力与升级，以及随时可能出现的意外遭遇，都让每一次冒险都截然不同。灵活调整策略，尝试威力惊人的组合，在第4区一路奋战——只要你有足够的实力与技巧活下来。
你能用每个角色征服进阶10吗?
Steam抢先体验版将提供5名可玩角色，其中4位各自拥有独特的卡池与玩法策略，第5名角色则可以使用机制独特的特殊牌组。此外，还有海量构筑组合等你发掘!
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790590584_929853_png_r.webp
游戏亮点
● 地图编辑器 & Steam 创意工坊： 亲手制作自己的地图并发布到创意工坊与全球玩家分享;也可以下载并游玩社区制作的热门地图!
● 完整手柄支持： 《Tower Tactics 2》从设计之初就充分考虑了手柄与 Steam Deck 的操作体验。
● 全新机制： 英雄卡、强力的临时增益效果、卡牌道具、燃烧、中毒、虚弱 等新状态效果，全新的战斗类型、敌人能力……内容多到停不下来!
● 更丰富的元进度： 装备不同的初始英雄卡与饰品来定制你的开局配置，在全面重制的圣所中献上强大的全新供品，进一步提升战力!
● 海量新内容： 新卡牌、新敌人、新地块、新牌组、新模式、新地图、新饰品……应有尽有。
Steam商店页： https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749130/Tower_Tactics_II/
《Tower Tactics 2》仍在持续扩展，未来还将推出更多任务，逐步揭开完整的故事篇章。
关于Assemble Entertainment
Assemble Entertainment 是一家总部位于德国的独立发行商，旗下拥有多款知名独立游戏，包括《小小贴纸铺》《Roadwarden》《驯牌师》《划划划》《无尽猎杀》以及《末日地带》系列。自 2016 年以来，Assemble 已发行超过 50 款涵盖多种类型的游戏(治愈、恐怖、策略、Roguelike 等)，并于业界建立起作为原创独立项目发行方的良好口碑。
关于asraworks
Asraworks是位于西班牙大加那利岛的个人独立游戏开发工作室，也是《Tower Tactics》系列的开发者。工作室致力于打造具有深层系统机制和极高重玩价值的策略游戏，将牌组构建、Roguelike成长与塔防元素巧妙结合，鼓励玩家大胆尝试，自由构筑、展现个性。《Tower Tactics 2》是工作室迄今为止规模最大的项目，它凝聚了多年来玩家的宝贵反馈，以及开发者对高耐玩度策略游戏的热忱。

items.title: AMD版DLSS5性能暴增74% 超高分辨率玩3A约50帧
items.summary: 据外媒Respawnfirst报道，此前有Mod开发者尝试让AMD Radeon显卡运行英伟达DLSS 5神经渲染技术，而该项目在过去24小时内连续推出两次…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281814029619.png
据外媒Respawnfirst报道，此前有Mod开发者尝试让AMD Radeon显卡运行英伟达DLSS 5神经渲染技术，而该项目在过去24小时内连续推出两次更新，使整体性能获得大幅提升。
DLSS 5神经渲染是英伟达最新推出的图像生成技术，可以通过神经网络进一步提升游戏中的光照、反射等画面效果，但由于需要进行大量计算，即便是在原生支持DLSS 5的GeForce显卡上也会产生较高的性能开销。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281814143102.png
由于AMD Radeon显卡并不原生支持DLSS 5，该Mod项目需要通过转换层等方式运行相关技术，因此早期版本存在明显的性能瓶颈。不过，开发者Daniel在短时间内针对相关问题进行了优化。
项目连续发布的两个版本分别带来了性能提升：
Alpha 0.3.3：加入图形化安装程序和覆盖层设置，同时相比此前版本提升约23%的性能。
Alpha 0.4.0：在前一版本基础上进一步优化，额外带来约42%的性能提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281814232666.png
按照相关测试，经过最新版本更新后，AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT运行《赛博朋克2077》时，在3440×1440分辨率下可以达到约50FPS。 该测试由科技频道Ancient Gameplays进行。
需要注意的是，上述性能提升数据来自项目开发者及第三方测试，目前该项目仍处于Alpha阶段，并非英伟达官方提供的AMD平台DLSS 5支持方案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/28/small_202609281814328813.png
开发者Daniel表示，后续还将继续针对项目进行性能优化。
此外，该项目并非近期唯一针对DLSS技术兼容性进行的非官方尝试。Mod社区此前也曾尝试让较旧的英伟达显卡运行DLSS 5多帧生成等新功能。相关项目的发展也让部分原本受到硬件支持限制的功能出现在更多显卡平台上。
目前，DLSS 5神经渲染在AMD Radeon显卡上的运行仍属于非官方Mod方案，实际性能和兼容性可能因显卡、游戏以及具体设置而有所不同。

content.v: 法国《反恐精英：全球攻势》前职业选手、主播Malek Bennouioua去世，年仅35岁。他以Malek这一名字为玩家熟知，其离世消息引发法国电竞圈，尤其是《反恐精英》社区的悼念。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790590488_639458_jpg_r.jpg
Malek于2026年9月27日至28日夜间去世。职业选手时期，他主要活跃于法国《反恐精英：全球攻势》赛场，曾担任队内指挥，以战术分析和临场判断受到关注。
他的职业经历包括效力于beGenius ESC和Epsilon.fr，也曾参加Gamers Assembly等法国线下赛事。2018年的DreamHack Tours赛事中，他取得过领奖台名次。此后，他逐渐将重心转向内容创作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260928/1790590493_742692.jpg
在Twitch和YouTube上，Malek分享比赛分析、战术教学和个人指导内容，关注者超过10万。他的讲解涉及站位、战术思路，以及紧急情况下的决策等竞技玩法。2022年，他还参加了Zack Nani的访谈节目，谈到自己对《反恐精英》的热爱。
离世消息传出后，Dan Madesclaire（apEX）、Richard Papillon（Shox）及教练Steeve Flavigni（Ozstrik3r）等人通过社交平台悼念Malek。Flavigni提到，Malek身后留下伴侣和两名年幼的孩子。

items.title: 触乐怪话：往往不完美，才是完美
items.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 小罗老师简直完美还原了现场（图/小罗） 昨天在草莓音乐节，我看了Belle and Sebastian的现场。他们是一支来自苏格兰格拉斯哥的乐队，是我最喜欢的indie

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-28/6aba33d8325cc.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
昨天在草莓音乐节，我看了Belle and Sebastian的现场。他们是一支来自苏格兰格拉斯哥的乐队，是我最喜欢的indie pop乐队之一。我听他们的作品十几年，这是第一次看现场。
演出排在下午四点。9月底的广州，太阳依旧毒辣，现场气温超过30℃，键盘手Sarah Martin在台上被热得遭不住，竟然打起阳伞。主唱Stuart Murdoch在换歌间隙，拿天气作为话题，调侃了几次。总的来说，这并不是一个适合听Belle and Sebastian音乐的场合。
如果你此前听过Belle and Sebastian的作品，或许会和我有相同的感受。他们的歌总给人一种很安心的感觉。无论忧愁，还是快乐，情绪起伏都很小，碎碎念的歌词里透露着一种平淡的浪漫。最适合听他们的时刻，大概是一个晴朗干燥的秋天傍晚，白日余温尚未散去，夜晚凉意已渐渐升起。
但就跟游戏上线时很难避免不出现bug，音乐节现场也很少有那种完美到极致的场合，天气、设备、乐手状态等等，都有可能出状况。
我上一次看音乐节是今年巴塞罗那的Primavera Sound。通常来说，6月初是巴塞罗那全年最干燥的时节，很少下雨。但今年音乐节第一天就遇上难得的大雨，不仅现场气温骤降，把我冻得不行，还因为防水不到位，导致线路故障，部分舞台演出推迟。而后又因为大风刮倒了舞台设施，导致部分演出直接取消。其中就包括当天最为重磅的音乐人Massive Attack和Doja Cat。

再上一次则是东莞的草莓音乐节，那也是一个下雨天。我冲着The Smiths的吉他手Johnny Marr去的。在The Smiths解散后，如今他带着自己的乐手来演出。在演到The Smiths的金曲《There Is a Light That Never Goes Out》时，雨势更大了。但怎么说呢，这首歌其实挺适合下雨听的。能看着雨滴在夜晚灯光照射下划出光线，现场听着这首哀伤情歌，大概也是很难复刻的浪漫瞬间。
而且我的“人生演出”之一，2023年底Pulp乐队在香港Clockenflap音乐节的那场，也是在意外情况下完成的：前一天乐队主唱Javis Cocker不小心摔断了肋骨，他仍然坚持演出。后来我又在东京的音乐节看过一场Pulp，但却没有能再次获得那天晚上在中环海滨活动空间和数万名乐迷一起合唱《Common People》的感动。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-28/5726aba0cc8d19e4.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

虽然我不断地在看音乐现场，但也一直在思考，现场音乐的魅力究竟在什么地方？有一个拿游戏来做对比的话题，我跟朋友们讨论过不少次。比如，一场Livehouse演出的门票通常是100到300块不等，也有更便宜，也有更贵的。不管怎么样，看一场演出花这么多钱，看90分钟就结束了。而同样的钱你用来买游戏，获得超过10小时的快乐体验轻而易举——还不用出门经受天气折磨。在娱乐消费性价比上，其它媒介如何能与游戏竞争呢？
不过，就像是旅行一样，在社交媒体上刷再多的照片和视频，最终还是得去到目的地，才能感受全貌。并且“逃离日常”作为一种行为本身，也拥有足够的吸引力。在流媒体上听再多遍喜欢的音乐人的歌曲，它能构成的回忆或者体验，都不如一次好的现场来得清晰。
就像去Primavera Sound之前，我也只是对Olivia Rodrigo抱有一种普通的好感。但看完她空降音乐节现场的完美救场演出之后，我每每想起那天晚上的热烈氛围，都还会觉得感动——尤其散场的时候，我竟然还看见了刚刚卸任曼城俱乐部主教练的瓜迪奥拉。这种谈资，也是现场体验的意义之一。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-09-28/3666aba0e07d6982.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
回到Belle and Sebastian吧。因为现场天气太热，主办方担心乐迷中暑，调来了几台喷雾车，通过人工制造“降水”来给大家降温。很巧的是，舞台坐东朝西，阳光从西南面照射过来，正好透过水雾折射出了一道完整的彩虹，跨过舞台两边。
有多少演出能看到这样的彩虹呢？从这个角度看，有时候bug确实能成为一种有趣的玩法。

items.title: 暴雪能否打破“星际争霸”系列的续作魔咒？
